description: Why have East Cobb's legislative district boundaries changed? Learn how redistricting shapes representation, why fair maps matter, and what it means for Georgia House District 45 and our community.

title: Who Represents East Cobb? | Fair Representation & Georgia House District 45 — Michelle Schreiner is a candidate for Georgia House District 45, rooted in East Cobb and focused on steady leadership, practical solutions, and real progress for Georgia families.
